definitions.completion: in the webview: from inserting `.` (the server's trigger character, `view.dispatch` with `input.type`) to the frame that painted the autocomplete popup with the server's first item (the end mark of every "frame" row: the DOM change that made it true, seen by a MutationObserver → the next animation frame → the first task after that frame, as typing's `painted`; each sample starts after a 0 – 16.7 ms pause so the start is not locked to the frame phase); 20 per run; per-run value = median
definitions.definition: answer → frame: from the fake server's stamp just before it wrote the `textDocument/definition` answer (a different file each time, so opening it is included) to the wall clock of the frame that painted that file's editor with the cursor on the target line; `gotoDeclaration` (⌘B's function) is called directly — keymap handling is not included; 10 per run; per-run value = median
definitions.diagnostics: publish → frame: from the fake server's stamp just before it wrote the `publishDiagnostics` that marks the edited line to the wall clock of the frame that painted that line's underline (`.pw-diagnostic`); 20 per run; per-run value = median. edit → frame (reference) also holds the client's `didChange`
definitions.idle: `lsp-idle`: this repository's copy registered trusted with the real server at `--lsp-server`; after the file opened and the server stayed ready for 15 s, wait idle_secs and sample phys_footprint; Pitwall's processes (`pitwall`, WebKit and the instance's helpers) and the server's (the descendants of the app process — the server is not in the app's responsible-pid group) are reported apart
definitions.memory: phys_footprint by the responsible-pid group plus the descendants of the app process (the language server and its children), sampled after the scenario (symbols: after the popups — the Rust index lives in the `pitwall` process)
definitions.problems: opening `src/problems.rs` makes the fake server publish 5 diagnostics to each of 2,000 files (10,000); after the status bar counts are complete: ⌘6 keydown → the frame that painted the first problem row; then fling top to bottom in 1500 frames, judged as 06 「스크롤 60fps」 (share within one refresh ≥ 0.95 and median interval ≤ 17 ms)
definitions.server: a fake language server (`pw-perf-lsp`) plugged into the bundled `rust-analyzer` definition by the global setting `[lsp.rust-analyzer] path`; it answers at once and stamps the wall clock of what it sent (the targets are Pitwall's side only, M4-D19)
definitions.symbols: a synthetic repository of 20,000 files and 500,000 symbols registered untrusted (no language server); first index = launch → `index.status` ready with nothing pending (polled every 50 ms on a connection of the same project); then, with no wait, the first popup (⌘⌥O for `symbols`, ⌘O for `classes`) and the query typed a character at a time: input event → the frame that painted that query's rows (`totalMs`), of which input event → the rows in the DOM (`seenMs`) and the `index.symbols.search` round trip (`rpcMs`, Host + IPC); the second popup is measured the same way afterwards (not a first use)
definitions.typing: 300 characters, each after a pause of 50 ms on average from the previous key's painted frame (about 15 keys a second) — each pause spread over one 16.7 ms frame so a key does not start at the same frame phase (as `offPhase`; typing figures before 2026-11-12 used a fixed 50 ms and are not comparable), each inserted with `view.dispatch` (`input.type`, keymap · IME not included); per key: insert → after the next frame's rendering (a message posted from the next animation frame); per-run value = p95. LSP on and off are separate runs (`lsp-typing` · `lsp-typing-off`, the latter with `[lsp.rust-analyzer] enabled = false`); 06 judges on − off ≤ 2 ms on the medians of the per-run p95
